payout_quote: B Positive donors are financially compensated for the time they spend donating blood plasma. New (first-time) donors can earn over $800* in their first month, and regular, repeat donors can earn up to $135* a week thereafter! Additionally, if you successfully refer donors to B Positive, you can earn an extra $10 per referral. ... Donors are issued a reloadable B Positive Visa Debit card at their first donation. All compensation, including referral bonuses, are then paid to your B Positive Visa Debit card. ... *May vary by location and donor and rates are subject to change without notice. We recommend setting aside at least 2.5 hours for your first plasma donation visit.
timing: Paid to reloadable B Positive Visa Debit card (usable anywhere Visa, ATM) after each donation
eligibility: Standard plasma donor criteria (18+, 110+ lbs, pass screening); up to 2x per 7 days with at least 1 day between; locations in PA/NJ (Philadelphia, Cheltenham, Atlantic City etc.)
steps: Schedule your first donation online at bpositiveplasma.com
Bring ID and documentation; set aside 2.5 hours for the first visit
Receive your B Positive Visa Debit card at first donation
Donate up to twice a week; regular donors earn up to $135/week
Refer friends for $10 each on the same Visa card
catches: Regional chain (PA/NJ area) — no use outside the Philadelphia/Atlantic City footprint.
Referral bonus is only $10 — one of the weakest in the industry.
First visit takes 2.5 hours; not everyone qualifies.
Rates vary by location and are subject to change without notice.
biggest_catch: B Positive is a solid regional option with strong first-month pay ($800+) and a high $135/week regular rate — but it only exists in the Philly/South Jersey area.

repeatable.cadence: Up to twice per week with at least 1 day between, indefinitely, as long as you keep passing screening — regular donors can earn up to $135/week ongoing; the first-month new-donor totals are one-time per person.
repeatable.note: Ongoing: up to twice per week indefinitely at up to $135/week. First-month $800+ is one-time; $10 referrals repeatable.

maximize: Do the full first month to capture the $800+ — that's where the headline money is. As a regular, keep the twice-weekly cadence: $135/week adds up to ~$540/month steady. The $10 referral is weak sauce compared to CSL/ADMA — don't count on it as an income lever here.

who_pays: B Positive Plasma pays everything — donation pay and referral bonuses — onto a reloadable B Positive Visa Debit card issued at your first donation, usable anywhere Visa is accepted and at ATMs.
who_qualifies: Standard plasma donor criteria: 18+, at least 110 lbs, and you must pass the medical screening. Every visit re-screens you; failing means no donation and no pay. Up to 2x per 7 days with at least 1 day between.
work_available: B Positive is a regional chain in PA/NJ (Philadelphia, Cheltenham, Atlantic City area) — no use outside that footprint. Rates "may vary by location and donor and are subject to change without notice," so confirm your center's current rate.
what_gets_accepted: Completed donations only — pass the day's health screening and finish the donation. The new-donor first-month totals require completing the early donation schedule.
costs_and_unpaid_time: Set aside 2.5 hours for the first visit (screening included) before any pay; return visits run about 90-180 minutes. A needle in your arm, twice-weekly trips, travel and waiting — all unpaid.
when_cash_arrives: Paid to your reloadable B Positive Visa Debit card after each donation.
